source_policy: Official issuer pages and documents only (plus Scapia, the fintech operator, for its reward programme). Pages that are JavaScript-rendered or bot-walled were read with a headless browser; every quote is verbatim from the recorded text. Overrides batch 2 for these cards.

cards.name: SimplyCLICK SBI Card

fees.quote: SimplyCLICK SBI Card 499 499 (Waived off on annual spends of Rs.1 Lakh or more in the | preceding year)

earn.quote: Earn 10X Reward Points on online spends with exclusive partners: Apollo 24x7, BookMyShow, Cleartrip, Dominos, IGP, Myntra, Netmeds, Swiggy, Yatra, Gyftr, Tata Cliq
earn.cap_quote: Cumulative 10X Reward Points accrued on online spends with exclusive partners on your SimplyCLICK SBI Card will have a capping of 10,000 Reward Points per month.
earn.note: 10X of the 1 RP per Rs. 100 base. Partner list is the product page as rendered on 2026-10-10; it names Swiggy, which the 1 Apr 2025 customer notice moved to 5X (the T&C partner table is an image, newest effective date 20 Mar 2026). Product page taken as current.

earn.quote: Earn 5X Reward Points on all other online spends
earn.cap_quote: 5X Reward Points are applicable for all online spends made other than on | exclusive partner brands and will be capped at 10,000 Reward Points per | calendar month. Post that, every Rs.100 spent will accrue 1 Reward Point.

earn.quote: Earn 1 Reward Point per Rs. 100 on all other spends

exclusions.what: cash advance, balance transfer, encash, Flexipay, offline fuel
exclusions.quote: Cash Advance, Balance Transfer, Encash, Flexipay and Offline Fuel transaction | (5172, 5541, 5983, 5542) are not included in Reward Points program.
e-Wallet loading transactions done using SimplyCLICK SBI Card on any partner | brand website/app identified under MCCs 6540 and 6541 (on best effort basis) | will not accrue Reward Points.
W.e.f. 01 Apr 2024, accrual of Reward Points on Rent Payment transactions with | SimplyCLICK will be discontinued.
W.e.f. 01 Jun 2024, accrual of Reward Points on Govt Related transactions with | SimplyCLICK will be discontinued.
W.e.f. 1 Dec 2024, accrual of Reward Points on spends done on Digital Gaming | Platforms/Merchants with SimplyCLICK will be discontinued.

exclusions.what: e-gift vouchers earn 10X only at the GyFTR portal
exclusions.quote: 10X Reward Points on e-Gift Voucher purchases shall be applicable only on | transactions made at GyFTR portal using SimplyCLICK Credit Card.

milestones.quote: E-Vouchers worth Rs. 2,000 each on reaching annual online spends of 1 Lakh and 2 Lakhs respectively
milestones.note: Counts online spends only; not mapped because milestones are modelled on total spend.

notes: Product page is JavaScript-rendered; read with the headless-browser fetch (Playwright) on 2026-10-10.
Utility bills paid on the SBI Card site/app do not earn 5X; Cleartrip and Yatra via affiliate channels do not earn 10X (rp-tnc). Not modelled (merchant-channel specific).
10X applies only to INR payments: '10X Reward Points are applicable only when payment is done in INR' (rp-tnc).

cards.name: AU Bank LIT Credit Card

fees.quote: LIT, InstaPay, AU KOSMO, ixigo AU, AU CA, AU CS, Paytm AU | AU Zaggle | Lifetime Free

earn.quote: Cardholders are eligible for earn rate of 1 Reward Point for every INR 100 retail spends done on the LIT Card.
earn.cap_quote: Cardholders can earn a maximum of 10000 Reward Points in a statement cycle.
earn.note: Base programme only. Paid 90-day feature packs (5X/10X points, category and milestone cashback) are out of scope.

earn.quote: Transactions on Utilities (subject to maximum capping of 100 RP per transaction) and Insurance transactions will continue to earn Base reward (1 Reward) on every Rs. 100 spent
earn.note: Same rate as the base; the 100 RP per-transaction cap on utilities is not modelled.

exclusions.what: cash withdrawal, BBPS, EMI, fuel, rent, education, government
exclusions.quote: Cash Withdrawal (MCC- 6010, 6011), BBPS, EMI, Fuel transactions (MCC- 5172, 5541, 5542, 5552 and 5983), Rent (MCC- 6513), Education & Govt ... transactions will not be considered for earning of Base Reward Points.

cards.point_value_quote: Redemption of Gift card’s/Vouchers/E-vouchers: Value of each Reward Points will be | INR 0.20 if redeemed against Gift card’s/Vouchers/E-vouchers. This will be applicable | for all AU Bank Credit Card variants.
notes: Product page, T&C and features page are behind Cloudflare (403 to plain HTTP); read with the headless-browser fetch on 2026-10-10. Each render takes about 30 s (Cloudflare challenge).

LIT T&C 'Last updated on 15th January, 2025'. Point-value notice dated 2 June 2023: other redemption routes 'remain unchanged' at a value it does not state; ₹0.20 (vouchers) is the only value in official text.

Paid 90-day packs (out of scope): 5X/10X Reward Points on online or offline spends, 5% grocery/apparel cashback, 5%/2% milestone cashback, lounge, fuel waiver. Accelerated 5X/10X exclude utilities, insurance, fuel, rent, education, government, cash.
BBPS bill payments earn nothing, but utilities paid outside BBPS earn the base rate; the exclusion therefore does not list utilities.
Redemption fee: 'Reward Points Redemption Fees: A nominal fees of Rs. 99 + GST will be levied on every successful redemption' (2023 notice).

cards.name: Scapia Federal Bank Credit Card

fees.quote: Card Name Scapia Federal Credit Card | Issued by Federal Bank | Joining Fees Nil | Annual Membership Fees Nil

earn.quote: Currently, on your Scapia Federal Visa Credit Card, you will earn 10% | rewards on every purchase of Rs. 20 and above.
earn.note: 10% in Scapia coins (1 reward = 1 coin), worth 2% at 5 coins = ₹1, travel-only redemption.

earn.quote: You will earn 20% rewards on travel purchases made on the Scapia | App.
Also, currently, on your Scapia Federal Rupay Credit Card, | you will earn 5% rewards on eligible spends of more than 500 Rs.
earn.note: Worth 1% at 5 coins = ₹1. Text says 'more than 500 Rs.'; modelled as ₹500 minimum.

exclusions.what: money transfers, rent, cash, EMI, forex, education, gift cards, card repayments, crypto, fuel, wallet loads, insurance, utilities/telecom
exclusions.quote: Rewards will not accrue for money transfers, rent payments, cash | withdrawals, EMI transactions, forex transaction, education and school fees, | gift cards, credit card repayments, crypto/digital asset transactions, fuel, fuel | surcharge, rent and digital wallet loading or top-up transactions, Insurance, | Utility, telecom and cable spends.
exclusions.note: Official text (Scapia-hosted Federal Bank cardholder agreement v10 27-02-26), but the allow-list makes Scapia official only for currency, earn rules and caps; exclusions need an issuer (Federal Bank) URL, and federal.bank.in serves a Radware bot wall to both plain HTTP and headless Chromium. Not mapped.

cards.coin_conversion_quote: Rewards earned on card transactions will be converted to Scapia coins | on the statement date with the conversion ratio 1 Reward = 1 Scapia | Coin.
cards.lounge: Unlimited domestic lounge access, unlocked on ₹20,000 combined monthly spend (scapia.cards).
notes: Coins redeem only for travel booked in the Scapia app: 'Use Scapia coins to book travel on the Scapia app' (scapia.cards).

On scapia.cards the card-spend and app-travel percentages are drawn as graphics; even after a browser render the text reads 'rewards on your card spends' with no number. The rates come from the cardholder agreement PDF linked from scapia.cards ('Card holder agreement - Federal Bank').
Federal Bank pages (KFS/MITC v10 27-02-26, card T&C v4 21-04-25) returned a Radware 'Verifying your browser' page on 2026-10-10 to both plain HTTP and headless Chromium.
